title: TDD RED evidence summary
description: Git-tracked summary of an expected RED test run. Raw test output is stored locally outside Git.

workItem.description: Stable lowercase identifier for one TDD cycle, normally based on its issue number.

sourceRevision.description: Full Git object ID used as the source baseline before the RED cycle.

testFiles.description: Exact Kotlin test files executed for RED and their post-edit SHA-256 fingerprints.

command.description: Executed command represented as arguments so shell quoting is not ambiguous.

failedTests.description: Stable names of tests that failed for the expected reason.

expectedFailureCategory.description: Expected failure caused by behavior that the production implementation does not provide yet.

recordedAt.description: UTC time when the RED result was observed.
